alignments.note: Rule 45: preposition plus governed demonstrative rendered by one English word answering to neither token separately, as diA touto -> wherefore; headed on the governed word.
Rule 86: a participle licenses the supplied subordinator, so 'seeing' is a rule 7 helper here; subject 'we' rides along and rule 9/17 heads on the lexical verb.
Rule 38: the attributive demonstrative tautEn supplies the English determiner 'this', so the article realizes nothing.
Rule 38: the demonstrative takes 'this' whether it precedes or follows the article.
Rule 82: kathOs is rendered 'even as' throughout the corpus, the supplied 'even' an intensifying helper on 'as'.
Rule 17/91: 'obtained' is the support verb and 'mercy' is what glosses eleAO, so the head is the meaning-bearing complement, as 'bear witness' heads on 'witness'.
Ordinary negative; no negative indefinite is in question, so rules 41 and 59 do not apply.
Rule 9: the subject rides with the inflected verb and the head is the lexical verb.
